title: Jimbocho, beyond the bookshop
intro: A different reading of Jimbocho: contemporary fashion, sporting goods and South Indian cooking. Hours for all three are recorded from their own websites.

title: Shibuya, tuned differently
intro: Three listening bars in rising order of lateness, from the station basement up into Maruyamacho. Only CAVE publishes its hours; confirm the other two before you go.

title: Higashiyama in different registers
intro: Temple, shrine, theatre and tearoom on a downhill line from Kiyomizu to the Shijo bridge. Gate times are official; the walk itself is map-checked, not walked.
stops: 甘味どころ ぎをん 小森

title: Ueno, beyond the museum doors
intro: Three museums and the pond inside one park. Admission, hours and closures are recorded from the museums' own pages; check Monday closures.

title: Kiyosumi, a slower morning
intro: Two coffee addresses and a yoshoku counter within 750 m. Published hours are thin here; one roastery's schedule differs between sources.
stops: 米本珈琲 清澄白河

title: Harajuku, different tempos
intro: Shrine at dawn pace, a daifuku shop that sells out by lunch, a burger counter, then the car-free street. The order follows each stop's time window.

title: Ebisu on the record
intro: Three small music bars within 900 m. Spincoaster publishes its hours; the other two could not be confirmed and should be treated as unconfirmed.
stops: ソウルソニックブギー恵比寿

title: Koenji, stay a little longer
intro: Dinner first at a diner that closes at 19:00, then a rum bar, a no-cover sake bar and a standing bar. Ordered by closing time, not by fame.

title: Shinjuku, the smaller streets
intro: One post-war alley, three counters. Everything is within 250 m; shop hours come from the alley association's own listings, some of them dated.
stops: 新宿西口 思い出横丁
そば処かめや 新宿店
四文屋 思い出横丁店

title: Namba, beyond the billboards
intro: Century-old curry first (it closes at 20:00), the bridge as the neon comes on, takoyaki last. Three stops within 1.2 km whose hours line up in this order.
stops: 本家大たこ 道頓堀本店
